name: 23456 · Virginia Bch, VA
findings: ZIP 23456 (Virginia Bch) has 175 nonprofit organizations. 83 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 75 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 23456 (Virginia Bch) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
